# C398 (inline) fetch_item retry delay + exhaustion alert
Found 2026-10-21: execute() delayed non-until_late retries with Retry.Base only; config sets Backoff=60s so fetch_item attempts ran 1s/2s apart (3 attempts inside seconds, ladder_daily burned its budget in 3s). Startup-type fetch_item exhaustion also never alerted (only non-startup events did). Fix both; test with fake clock (>=3min of backoff, exactly one alert).
